title: Build minimal Boss admin UI for personnel Plant access and audit
verify: Boss UI can view personnel, create local Engineer invite, assign role, view Plant list, manage Plant access, toggle plant_approve_actions, and view audit list.
Admin UI notices are presentation-only and do not enter agent context, Bus, MessageEnvelope, timeline replay as mutable state, or Plant facts.
Non-Boss users cannot reach admin UI functions through backend routes even if UI paths are manipulated.
evidence_required: Frontend/unit or component test output for admin controls.
E2E output for Boss admin first-demo path.
Screenshot or artifact path may be attached under .tasks/TASK-014/ if UI is rendered.
constraints: Frontend UI is presentation only; backend authorization and audit writes are authoritative.
Minimal first-demo admin surface is allowed but must support Boss plus at least one Engineer path.
No hosted invite delivery, recovery, SaaS tenancy, or broad HR/personnel management UI.
invariants: .memory-bank/tech-specs/FT-003-boss-admin-surface-admin-audit.md: admin UI success/error notices are presentation only.
.memory-bank/testing/index.md: UI/e2e checks are required for real user flows.
verification_targets: .memory-bank/testing/index.md: E2E Boss creates Engineer, grants tomato_001 access, and sees admin audit.
